mission: Ship StoryEngine to feature-complete. Every pipeline stage gets a working UI. No polish until everything works end-to-end.

lead.name: Orchestrator
lead.description: Analyzes the full pipeline daily. Maps what exists vs what's missing. Creates the task list. Assigns work. Advances to the next tab only when QA confirms 100% complete.

agents.name: Backend Dev
agents.description: Builds API routes, Pydantic models, database migrations, and backend wiring. Ensures every pipeline action has a working endpoint.

agents.name: Frontend Dev
agents.description: Builds UI components, pages, TypeScript types, and API client calls. Wires every backend endpoint to a visible, interactive UI element.

agents.name: QA Engineer
agents.description: Runs tsc --noEmit, curls endpoints, runs Playwright checks. Verifies every button works, every API call succeeds, every type matches. Fails tasks back to Backend/Frontend if broken.
